rules.title: Argument format
rules.description: A command argument must match the expected naming format.
rules.agent_guidance: Check the command usage and retry with the expected identifier format.

rules.title: Required directory exists
rules.description: A required repository directory must exist.
rules.agent_guidance: Create the missing directory or update the standard if the directory is no longer required.

rules.title: Required file exists
rules.description: A required repository file must exist.
rules.agent_guidance: Create the missing file, restore it, or update the standard if the file is no longer required.

rules.title: Required artifact or field
rules.description: A required artifact, section, or field is missing.
rules.agent_guidance: Inspect the referenced artifact and add the missing required structure.

rules.title: Required text reference
rules.description: A text artifact must include a required reference.
rules.agent_guidance: Update the referenced artifact so it includes the required standard pointer.

rules.title: JSON parses
rules.description: A JSON schema or output file must parse as JSON.
rules.agent_guidance: Fix JSON syntax before making semantic changes.

rules.title: Schema URI declared
rules.description: A JSON Schema file must declare `$schema`.
rules.agent_guidance: Add the JSON Schema draft URI to the schema file.

rules.title: Schema ID declared
rules.description: A JSON Schema file must declare `$id`.
rules.agent_guidance: Add a stable schema ID to the schema file.

rules.title: Schema title
rules.description: A JSON Schema file must declare the expected title.
rules.agent_guidance: Update the schema title or the check expectation so they match intentionally.

rules.title: Required field declared
rules.description: A manifest, spec, or schema must declare a required field.
rules.agent_guidance: Add the missing field with a valid value according to the relevant standard.

rules.title: Required field group exists
rules.description: A manifest or spec must contain a required field group.
rules.agent_guidance: Add the missing group and keep its structure aligned with the source standard.

rules.title: Minimum artifact count
rules.description: A repository artifact collection must contain at least the expected number of items.
rules.agent_guidance: Create the missing artifact or update the standard if the collection is no longer required.

rules.title: Required Markdown section
rules.description: A Markdown document must include a required section.
rules.agent_guidance: Add the missing section and preserve the expected heading text.

rules.title: Required Markdown heading
rules.description: A Markdown document must include the expected top-level heading.
rules.agent_guidance: Update the document heading so it matches the standard for that artifact type.

rules.title: Required Markdown metadata
rules.description: A Markdown document must include required metadata fields.
rules.agent_guidance: Add the missing metadata field near the top of the document.

rules.title: Unique Markdown identifier
rules.description: A numbered Markdown record such as an ADR must use a repository-unique identifier.
rules.agent_guidance: Rename the duplicate record to the next available identifier and update its heading and references.

rules.title: Module registry match
rules.description: A module manifest must match the module registry entry.
rules.agent_guidance: Align `.arch/modules.yaml` and `modules/<module>/module.yaml`.

rules.title: Contract registry declared
rules.description: The contract registry must exist and declare the expected source format and decision.
rules.agent_guidance: Inspect `.arch/contracts.yaml` and align it with the contract source format decision.

rules.title: Contract registry entry
rules.description: A registered module contract entry must declare an id and source path in the expected location.
rules.agent_guidance: Update `.arch/contracts.yaml` so each command, query, event, error catalog, and permission catalog has a valid entry.

rules.title: Boundary-only contract module
rules.description: A registered module may intentionally have no public command, query, event, error, or permission contracts while it is only an ownership boundary.
rules.agent_guidance: Do not invent contracts just to satisfy checks. Ratify the public API first, then add contract source files and registry entries.

rules.title: Contract source exists
rules.description: A registered contract source file must exist.
rules.agent_guidance: Create the missing contract source file or update the registry path.

rules.title: Contract source field
rules.description: A contract source file must declare required fields such as schema_version and status.
rules.agent_guidance: Open the contract source file and add the missing required field.

rules.title: Contract source match
rules.description: A contract source file must match the registry and module manifest declarations.
rules.agent_guidance: Align the contract source, `.arch/contracts.yaml`, and `modules/<module>/module.yaml`.

rules.title: Protocol source root
rules.description: The Protobuf source root and expected module-level source paths must exist when required by the protocol alignment status.
rules.agent_guidance: Inspect `proto/`, `.arch/contracts.yaml`, and `.arch/runtime.yaml`; create the expected source directory or make the alignment status explicit before adding Protobuf files.

rules.title: Protocol framework manifest
rules.description: The game protocol framework manifest must exist and declare the accepted WebSocket Protobuf envelope, routing, session, target, authority, and compatibility model.
rules.agent_guidance: Inspect `.arch/protocol.yaml`, `docs/game-protocol.md`, and ADR-0015 before adding or changing protocol files.

rules.title: Planned missing Protobuf source
rules.description: A registered contract has a planned Protobuf source or message, but missing `.proto` files are still allowed by the current alignment status.
rules.agent_guidance: Treat this as a planning signal. Before creating `.proto` files, run `node tools/vibit check protocol` and keep the new source aligned with the reported expected path and messages.

rules.title: Protocol package
rules.description: A Protobuf source file must declare the expected package for its owning module and version.
rules.agent_guidance: Use package `vibit.<module>.v1` for `proto/vibit/<module>/v1/<module>.proto` unless a later protocol ADR changes the layout.

rules.title: Protocol message
rules.description: A Protobuf source file must declare the expected wire messages for registered commands, queries, and events.
rules.agent_guidance: Add or correct messages generated from registered contract IDs, such as `<Command>Request`, `<Command>Response`, `<Query>Request`, `<Query>Response`, and event names.

rules.title: Protocol enum value
rules.description: A Protobuf enum must declare the expected values for protocol message kinds, target scopes, or other compatibility-sensitive protocol concepts.
rules.agent_guidance: Compare the enum with `.arch/protocol.yaml` and the governing ADR before adding, removing, or renumbering values.

rules.title: Protocol field
rules.description: A Protobuf source file must expose fields matching the registered semantic contract payload, input, and output property names.
rules.agent_guidance: Compare the failing field with the corresponding file under `contracts/<module>/` and update the Protobuf source or contract intentionally.

rules.title: Protocol source trace
rules.description: A Protobuf source file must include trace metadata pointing back to the semantic contract sources it represents.
rules.agent_guidance: Add a source trace comment that references the relevant `contracts/` path or an `@source` marker before generated output is created.

rules.title: Protocol Buf configuration
rules.description: Buf configuration must declare the Protobuf source root, lint policy, breaking-change policy, Go generation plugin, output path, and source-relative generation mode.
rules.agent_guidance: Inspect `buf.yaml`, `buf.gen.yaml`, ADR-0013, and ADR-0016 before changing Protobuf generation configuration.

rules.title: Protocol envelope
rules.description: The protocol envelope Protobuf source must exist and declare the expected envelope, target, session, and error message shape.
rules.agent_guidance: Keep `proto/vibit/protocol/v1/envelope.proto` aligned with `.arch/protocol.yaml`, `docs/game-protocol.md`, and the accepted envelope ADR.

rules.title: Protocol Go package
rules.description: A Protobuf source file must declare the expected Go package option for generated Go output.
rules.agent_guidance: Align `option go_package` with the runtime generated output path and ADR-0014 before running Protobuf generation.

rules.title: Generated output declared
rules.description: A module manifest must declare generated files and directories that belong to the module.
rules.agent_guidance: Update `modules/<module>/module.yaml` so generated outputs are explicit.

rules.title: Generated output exists
rules.description: A generated file declared by a module manifest must exist on disk.
rules.agent_guidance: Run the generator or update the module manifest declaration.

rules.title: Generated output root
rules.description: A generated output root must exist and contain only allowed placeholder or generated files for its current phase.
rules.agent_guidance: Inspect the generated output standard and keep handwritten runtime code outside generated roots.

rules.title: Generated file shape
rules.description: A generated file must use the expected suffix and file shape for its generator and output root.
rules.agent_guidance: Regenerate the file with the accepted generator or move handwritten code out of the generated output root.

rules.title: Generated output trace
rules.description: A generated file must include trace metadata for its source and generator.
rules.agent_guidance: Regenerate the file or update the generator so it emits generated, source, and generator markers.

rules.title: Generated source trace
rules.description: A generated file must trace back to an existing source artifact.
rules.agent_guidance: Fix the source trace by regenerating from an existing source file; do not hand-edit generated output to mask drift.

rules.title: Handwritten generated-root code forbidden
rules.description: Handwritten runtime code is forbidden under generated output roots.
rules.agent_guidance: Move handwritten code to the correct runtime package and keep generated roots reserved for generated output.

rules.title: Generated contract shape
rules.description: Each registered generated-shape semantic contract, including runtime authentication, must have an inspectable generated Go contract shape.
rules.agent_guidance: Run `node tools/vibit generate contract-shapes all` and then `node tools/vibit check generated --json`.

rules.title: Generated output drift
rules.description: Generated output must match the current generator output for its source artifact.
rules.agent_guidance: Regenerate the artifact from source; do not hand-edit generated output.

rules.title: Migration source root
rules.description: PostgreSQL migration sources must live under the accepted runtime migration root.
rules.agent_guidance: Use `runtime/migrations/postgres/` for SQL-first PostgreSQL migration sources unless a superseding decision changes the layout.

rules.title: Migration file shape
rules.description: PostgreSQL SQL migration files must use deterministic sequence names and the accepted `.sql` shape.
rules.agent_guidance: Rename the migration to the `000001_name.sql` pattern or update the migration standard intentionally.

rules.title: Migration goose marker
rules.description: SQL migrations must declare both goose Up and Down sections.
rules.agent_guidance: Add `-- +goose Up` and `-- +goose Down` sections before treating the migration as reviewable source.

rules.title: Migration source trace
rules.description: Architecture manifests, standards, and module guidance must point to the accepted migration source root and first migration.
rules.agent_guidance: Update `.arch/runtime.yaml`, `.arch/conventions.yaml`, persistence docs, and module/runtime guides so future agents can find migration ownership.

rules.title: Migration ownership
rules.description: A migration that creates module-owned state must declare ownership and reference the expected module-owned tables.
rules.agent_guidance: Add an owning module trace comment and align created tables with the relevant module manifest and persistence boundary.

rules.title: Go migration forbidden by default
rules.description: Go migrations are forbidden unless a change spec explicitly explains why SQL is insufficient.
rules.agent_guidance: Prefer SQL migrations. If a Go migration is truly required, create a change spec and decision record before adding it.

rules.title: PostgreSQL verification environment standard
rules.description: The disposable PostgreSQL verification environment standard, manifests, and guidance artifacts must declare opt-in live database verification rules.
rules.agent_guidance: Update `docs/postgresql-verification-environment.md`, its translation, and the related manifests or guides so agents can distinguish source checks from optional live PostgreSQL verification.

rules.title: Runtime implementation not started
rules.description: The server runtime check may pass as not applicable before the Go runtime exists.
rules.agent_guidance: Do not create runtime code only to satisfy this check; add Go runtime verification when implementation begins.

rules.title: Runtime Go module
rules.description: The Go runtime module file must exist at the ADR-0014 path and declare the accepted module path.
rules.agent_guidance: Use `runtime/go.mod` with module path `github.com/iceiko/vibit/runtime` unless a superseding ADR changes the runtime layout.

rules.title: Runtime skeleton

rules.title: Runtime protocol adapter boundary

rules.title: Runtime import boundary
